fact: The Internet Society Foundation announced on 2026-02-26 a 2025 Sustainable Peering Infrastructure grant to upgrade the switching fabric of the Lilongwe Open Neutral Internet Exchange (LIONEX) in Malawi for higher port speeds that benefit current peers and let more members join; no member count is given, and the date is the announcement's.

MISPA states the Malawi Internet Exchange (MIX) at the College of Medicine in Blantyre became operational on 4 December 2008, with Broadband/Burco, the College of Medicine and Malawi SDNP peering at start-up.

MISPA's table of 14 November 2024 shows 11 networks peering at the MIX at the College of Medicine and 9 (TNM, Afrimax, Airtel, Globe, INQ, MAREN, MTL, OCL, Simbanet) already peering after its migration to the National Data Centre.
The Internet Society says that in Malawi the Lilongwe Internet Exchange (LLIX) launched with five peers; the article gives no launch date, so its published date 2026-07-13 is used.
A MACRA Director General slide deck states Malawi has one IXP, in Blantyre (Southern region); the deck is undated and its latest internal date is September 2023, so 2023-10 is a proxy.
The MACRA deck states Malawi has only one IXP, in Blantyre; no networks from abroad are mentioned; the deck is undated, latest internal date September 2023, so 2023-10 is a proxy.
